pairs.subject: Mandatory Compliance Training
pairs.desc:
Dear Team,

As part of our commitment to compliance, all employees are required to complete the mandatory compliance training by the end of this month. The training module is designed to help you understand the policies and procedures that govern our operations.

Please find the training document attached. Make sure to review it thoroughly and complete the online assessment afterward.

If you have any questions, feel free to reach out.

Best regards,

HR Department
pairs.explain: This email is from the HR department regarding mandatory training with a legitimate attachment.

pairs.subject: Urgent: Compliance Training Required
pairs.desc:
Dear Employee,

You must complete the compliance training immediately. Failure to do so will result in disciplinary action. Please download the attached file and follow the instructions carefully.

This is a critical requirement, and your prompt attention is necessary.

Thank you,

HR Department
pairs.explain: This email uses urgency to prompt action and has a suspicious executable attachment.

pairs.subject: IT System Maintenance Notification
pairs.desc:
Dear Team,

We want to inform you that there will be scheduled maintenance on our IT systems this weekend. The maintenance window will start at 10 PM on Saturday and end at 6 AM on Sunday.

During this time, access to certain systems may be limited. We appreciate your understanding and patience during this process.

If you have any questions, please reach out to the IT helpdesk.

Thank you,

IT Department
pairs.explain: This email provides information about scheduled maintenance without any attachments, which is typical for IT notifications.

pairs.subject: Immediate Action Required: IT Maintenance
pairs.desc:
Hello,

Due to urgent issues, we need you to run the attached maintenance instructions on your computer immediately. This will help us resolve the problems affecting our systems.

Failure to comply may result in further issues with your access.

Best,

IT Department
